Found inside car on windscreen this evening 15 July 2025. No food in car so very odd sighting. Found 5 or 6 sitting on my windscreen (inside car) on Saturday 12 July 2025 , again nothing in car to cause fruit fly to be inside. Fruit trees have been spot flowering OFF season during autumn and winter 2025 for the first time since ive lived here for a decade. The fruit is not falling off trees properly and dying on the vine still attached to the tree. I wonder if this is why these fruit flies have appeared now.

raw_occurrenceRemarks: On cultivated *Citrus reticulata*.
On cultivated *Citrus sinensis*.

This little fella is about 5-6mm across. Striking eyes that appear marbled red-blue. Thorax has a number of shiny black panels over a dull white background. Abdomen is a series of yellow and white stripes each less than 0.5mm thick. Wings are transparent but have orange and black tiger-like stripes and patterns. Towards the anterior end of the wings are an intricate black maze pattern.Unfortunately I believe this to be one of the most despised agricultural pests worldwide and I'm not sure it is well established in California. Should this sighting be reported?
3 days old

I really hope this isn't a Mediterranean fruit fly but I was the first to report a on series of outbreaks that have happened across metropolitan Adelaide. None have been seen for a while and if this is one I spotted resting in my shed I want to know and will report to PIRSA. More pics available if required.
